## Start here

<Callout variant="tip">
**New to Tiger Data?** Begin with [Your first hypertable](/build/how-to/your-first-hypertable), then try a [guided project](/build/examples) like the IoT sensor simulation.

**Building for production?** Jump straight to [Write and query data](/build/data-management) and then explore [jobs and retention](/build/data-management/jobs) or [storage tiering](/build/data-management/storage/manage-storage).
</Callout>
